ana (Partnerships): FYI KernelWorks + CloudScale want us to support a new SA-west1 region (partner-managed infra) for Redwood Dedicated. They asked for marketplace listing + dedicated nodepool certification. timeline: ~6 weeks. who's the owner for quota + KMS + perf tests?

jordan (Cloud): I can take quota/KMS. need exact SKU list from CloudScale. do we have a recommended nodepool profile?

sam (EngInfra): We should require SR-IOV + low-jitter NICs for latency-sensitive pools. propose: 24GB GPU profile, 8-16 vCPU host, 512GB NVMe. also need network egress estimate for cost commit.

maria (Product): KernelWorks wants guaranteed 99th p99 latency SLA for their customers. do we have a test harness we can run in partner env?

sam (EngInfra): We do. I'll spin up the perf harness (kv-cache warm + continuous batching) and run 12-hour stability + p99 tail tests. need access creds to partner staging.

tom (Ops): For marketplace listing we need legal signoff + a certified infra checklist. @lee can you confirm required contract addenda for partner-managed nodes and KMS integration?

lee (Legal): Short answer: yes — need a Data Processing Addendum + explicit KMS key authority flow. Also need clarifications on incident notification timelines for partner-run infra. I can draft a template within 3 days.

ana (typo in earlier message) — ignore

ana (Partnerships): (correcting) ana here — Tom, can you attach the marketplace metadata template? KernelWorks asked for our listing copy.

tom (Ops): Attaching wire copy in minutes. core fields: region name, supported SKUs, pricing tiers (on-demand vs reserved), SLA, KMS options. will add a special "low-latency" SKU tag.

jordan (Cloud): Quota ask: partners requested 60 GPUs initially and burst to 120 for first month. We can request quota from CloudScale but need internal approval to reserve. Sam, are those numbers OK for perf tests + canary?

sam (EngInfra): 60 GPUs is fine for canary + initial pad. For safety please split across two nodepools so we can failover: pool-A (30 gpus), pool-B (30 gpus).

maria (Product): Marketing wants a joint announcement but only after we validate p99 and security checklist. target: hold announcement until week 6. KernelWorks asked for co-branded one-pager.

ana (typo again) — ignore
\nlee (Legal): Also flag: KMS cross-account key policy needs to be reviewed. Partner-managed keys require clear ownership lines in SOW.

ana (this keeps happening) — sorry, my autocomplete is broken

ana (Partnerships): last one, promise :) Ana — updated: KernelWorks provided SKU mapping: 
```
- gpu_type: cloudscale-v100x
- host_cpu: n2d-highmem-16
- disk: 1x1TB NVMe
- network: 25Gb SR-IOV
```
Can infra confirm compatibility?

sam (EngInfra): cloudscale-v100x maps to our internal 24GB GPU profile. compatibility OK but we'll recommend 32GB for heavy-context workloads. will run regressions.

jordan (Cloud): Action items: 1) I request partner quota reservation (today) 2) Sam runs perf harness (start tomorrow) 3) Lee drafts DPA + KMS clauses (3d) 4) Tom prepares marketplace metadata (2d) 5) Maria holds announcement draft until perf pass.

ana (Partnerships): thanks — can everyone drop ETA in this thread so we can sync with KernelWorks on Monday?

sam (EngInfra): perf harness start Tue 09:00 PT, initial p99 report Wed EOD.

jordan (Cloud): quota request sent to CloudScale partner rep (ref: CS-REQ-4321). ETA 48-72h. KMS workflow doc posted to drive.

lee (Legal): DPA + KMS clause draft by Thu EOD.

tom (Ops): Marketplace wire copy + low-latency SKU tag by Wed morning.

maria (Product): Announcement hold; I'll prepare co-brand draft by Thu and wait for perf green.

deploy-bot: [deploy] perf-harness/job-901 queued by sam — will post logs here.

ana (Partnerships): Great — I'll coordinate KernelWorks kickoff once we have quota ack. please ping if blockers come up. :thumbsup:

sam (EngInfra): noted. leaving a checklist here: 
- SR-IOV enabled
- KV-cache warmup script attached
- 12h stability run + p99 report
- failover test across pool-A/pool-B

jordan (Cloud): noted, will include quota ranges and burst policy in the partner agreement.

ana (Partnerships): thanks all — I'll update KernelWorks after quota ack. meeting Monday 10am PT if quota confirmed.
